messages:
rachel_sales: Hey team — Polaris Analytics is asking for a bespoke enterprise offer. Exec sponsor pushing to sign this week. They want: 30% off list for year 1, a $150k committed spend (can be annualized), and a 3-month POC on dedicated capacity (handles PHI). Can we move fast?

mike_dealdesk: tagging this for deal desk review. quick Qs: what's the expected ARR post-POC, and are we talking Redwood Dedicated or Private (VPC/on-prem)? Need margin band and precedent.

rachel_sales: It's Redwood Dedicated (they need isolation, but not full on-prem). Expected ARR if they convert is ~$600k/yr after year 1 (conservative). POC is 3 months, goal is production by month 4. I uploaded the draft SOW to the shared drive.

leah_finance: 30% is steep. At $150k commit that's $105k revenue first year. Need per-token cost baseline and estimated gross margin after infra & support. Also, any multi-year commit? We can consider a higher discount if they move to 12-mo commit and $200k.

omar_se: technical note — Dedicated + PHI triggers our higher-assurance checklist. We'll need SOC2 evidence, a signed BAA, and a short runbook for the POC (KV cache/data retention settings). Also: POC success criteria: throughput 50 rps/instance, 95th pct latency <150ms.

anna_security: Polaris sent a security questionnaire (500+ Qs). We need them to accept a standard security addendum to avoid going line-by-line. Data residency: they want EU-only for the PII subset. That affects region routing.

mike_dealdesk: Proposed commercial compromise: approve up to 25% off for year 1 if they: 1) increase commit to $200k annualized, or 2) sign a 12-month contract with a 6-month POC credit applied. Also require BAA + completed security checklist (or our addendum). If they push for 30%, this needs VP sign-off.

rachel_sales: Understood. I can push $200k/12mo. Their exec prefers the 30% ask but may accept 25 with the higher commit. I'll flag VP escalation if needed.

deal-bot: Discount approval request submitted: https://redwood.internal/dealdesk/requests/DR-2026-1387 (status: pending).

leah_finance: If we approve 25% at $200k, run the unit-econ calc and confirm minimum gross margin >= 40%. Also add clause: POC usage beyond agreed token cap billed at list.

omar_se: For engineering: to support EU-only residency we need to pin clusters in eu-west-1 and enable KV partitioning. This is doable but estimate 5 business days to schedule. POC SOW should include region/instance types.

anna_security: I'll draft the security addendum today and send to Polaris counsel. Requesting their lead sec contact so we can close the questionnaire faster.

mike_dealdesk: Final call: I'm approving a conditional 25% discount if Rachel confirms $200k commit + signed BAA + security addendum accepted + POC success criteria in SOW. If Rachel cannot get $200k, we can approve 20% with same security conditions. For 30% we need VP approval — please escalate with an exec justification doc.

rachel_sales: Perfect. I'll update the SOW with the POC success metrics and the $200k/12mo option, loop in Polaris sec contact, and ping for VP escalation if they insist on 30%. Thanks all — moving to get signatures. :pray:

mike_dealdesk: Noted. Put the redlined pricing sheet in the deal request. Once finance signs off on margin calc, I'll mark as approved.

deal-bot: Deal status updated to "conditions agreed" in the system. Next step: finance margin review.
